title: ScenarioSpec v1
description: Declarative, project-owned testing scenario. Product scenarios live in the owning project (e.g. TransformFit); the compiler resolves adapters and produces a RunManifest.

persona.description: Named user persona for AI user-testing sessions.

budget.description: Required whenever a required adapter is a paid provider; enforced by the compiler.

argv.description: Materialized command line for this run. Each argv must still prefix-match one of the selected adapter's commandAllowlist entries at preflight; no shell, no absolute-path arguments outside the sandbox.

env.description: Non-secret env names passed into the execution child (adapter-passthrough channel). Credentials never travel here; preflight's credential gate still applies.

server.description: App-under-test server: spawned in the worktree after provision, awaited on readyUrl, killed with its process group at run end. Readiness failure blocks the run (app_server_unavailable).

execution.description: Optional materialized execution plan. Without it the runner falls back to the adapter's allowlist head, exactly as before.
